parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Substitute and remove conjugates to obtain a correct equation in $x$ and $y$ - B1; for example $(x+2)-i(y+1)+(2+i)(x+iy)=0$. Use $i^2=-1$ and equate real and imaginary parts to zero - M1. Obtain two correct equations, for example $3x-y+2=0$ and $x+y-1=0$ - A1; allow $xi+yi-i=0$. Solve and obtain $z=-\frac14+\frac54i$ - A1; allow real and imaginary parts separately. Printed total: 4.
